	TFEmbarqueHoraFin_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_EmbarqueHoraFinAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFEmbarqueFecha_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_EmbarqueFechaAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFEmbarqueOrderDeliveryDate_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_EmbarqueOrderDeliveryDateAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFEmbarqueOrderDate_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_EmbarqueOrderDateAuxDateText.InternalName)
	TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio_RangePicker.Attach(&DDO_EmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicioAuxDateText.InternalName)
	Cell_Grid_DWC.Class = !'Invisible WCD_' + upper(Grid.InternalName)
	
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = 'Embarques'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		&OrderedDsc = True
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'Embarques.ListadoEmbarquesColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'Embarques.ListadoEmbarquesColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	EmbarqueCodigo.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	EmbarqueFolioCarga.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	EmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	EmbarqueOrderDate.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	EmbarqueOrderDeliveryDate.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	EmbarqueDiffDiasPedido.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	EmbarqueDiffDiasEntrega.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(7).IsVisible
	EmbarqueFecha.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(8).IsVisible
	EmbarqueHoraFin.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(9).IsVisible
	EmbarqueCliente.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(10).IsVisible
	EmbarqueProductoNombre.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(11).IsVisible
	EmbarqueDetalleCantidadPallets.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(12).IsVisible
	EmbarqueOrderDoc.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(13).IsVisible
	EmbarqueRemissionDoc.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(14).IsVisible
	EmbarqueTransporte.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(15).IsVisible
	EmbarquePlacas.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(16).IsVisible
	EmbarqueConductor.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(17).IsVisible
	EmbarqueNoProductos.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(18).IsVisible
	EmbarqueEstatus.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(19).IsVisible
	EmbarqueDetalleConfirmadoPorAdministracion.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(20).IsVisible
	Do 'InitializeTotalizers'
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	Do 'CalculateTotalizers'
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueCodigo'
					&TFEmbarqueCodigo = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueCodigo_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueFolioCarga'
					&TFEmbarqueFolioCarga = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueFolioCarga_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio'
					&TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio_To.Set(&TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio_To.Year(), &TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio_To.Month(), &TFEmbarqueHoraEstimadaInicio_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueOrderDate'
					&TFEmbarqueOrderDate.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueOrderDate_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueOrderDeliveryDate'
					&TFEmbarqueOrderDeliveryDate.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueOrderDeliveryDate_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueDiffDiasPedido'
					&TFEmbarqueDiffDiasPedido.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueDiffDiasPedido_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueDiffDiasEntrega'
					&TFEmbarqueDiffDiasEntrega.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueDiffDiasEntrega_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueFecha'
					&TFEmbarqueFecha.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueFecha_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueHoraFin'
					&TFEmbarqueHoraFin.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueHoraFin_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
					If Not &TFEmbarqueHoraFin_To.IsEmpty()
						&TFEmbarqueHoraFin_To.Set(&TFEmbarqueHoraFin_To.Year(), &TFEmbarqueHoraFin_To.Month(), &TFEmbarqueHoraFin_To.Day(), 23, 59, 59)
					EndIf
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueCliente'
					&TFEmbarqueCliente = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueCliente_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueProductoNombre'
					&TFEmbarqueProductoNombre = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueProductoNombre_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueDetalleCantidadPallets'
					&TFEmbarqueDetalleCantidadPallets.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueDetalleCantidadPallets_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueOrderDoc'
					&TFEmbarqueOrderDoc = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueOrderDoc_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueRemissionDoc'
					&TFEmbarqueRemissionDoc = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueRemissionDoc_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueTransporte'
					&TFEmbarqueTransporte = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueTransporte_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarquePlacas'
					&TFEmbarquePlacas = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarquePlacas_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueConductor'
					&TFEmbarqueConductor = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFEmbarqueConductor_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueNoProductos'
					&TFEmbarqueNoProductos.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get)
					&TFEmbarqueNoProductos_To.FromString(DDO_Grid.FilteredTextTo_get)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueEstatus'
					&TFEmbarqueEstatus_SelsJson = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
					&TFEmbarqueEstatus_Sels.FromJson(&TFEmbarqueEstatus_SelsJson)
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'EmbarqueDetalleConfirmadoPorAdministracion'
					&TFEmbarqueDetalleConfirmadoPorAdministracion_Sel.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */ &Update = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Update) &Update.Link = DB.EmbarqueDetalle.Link(TrnMode.Update, EmbarqueDetalleId) Endif &Delete = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Delete) &Delete.Link = DB.EmbarqueDetalle.Link(TrnMode.Delete, EmbarqueDetalleId) Endif &GridActions.Clear() &GridActions.AddItem(0, !";fa fa-bars") If &IsAuthorized_CambiarFecha If (EmbarqueEstatus = EstatusEmbarque.Programado or EmbarqueEstatus = EstatusEmbarque.PorProgramar) &GridActions.AddItem(1, 'Actualizar Datos') Endif EndIf If (EmbarqueEstatus = EstatusEmbarque.Programado) &GridActions.AddItem(2, 'Cargar') Endif If &IsAuthorized_Continuar If (EmbarqueEstatus = EstatusEmbarque.EnProceso) &GridActions.AddItem(3, 'Continuar Cargando') Endif EndIf If &IsAuthorized_cmdCretificadoCalidad If (EmbarqueEstatus = EstatusEmbarque.Finalizado) &GridActions.AddItem(4, 'Cert. Calidad') Endif EndIf If &IsAuthorized_cmdValeSalida If (EmbarqueEstatus = EstatusEmbarque.Finalizado) &GridActions.AddItem(5, 'Vale Salida') Endif EndIf If &GridActions.Count = 1 &GridActions.Class = !'Invisible' Else &GridActions.Class = !'ConvertToDDO' EndIf &DetailWebComponent = !'' If (EmbarqueEstatus in (EstatusEmbarque.EnProceso, EstatusEmbarque.Finalizado)) &DetailWebComponent.Class = !'Attribute' Else &DetailWebComponent.Class = !'Invisible' Endif &Display = !'' If (&IsAuthorized_Display) &Display.Link = EmbarqueView.Link(EmbarqueId, &TabCode) Endif /* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'Embarques.ListadoEmbarquesFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'Embarques.ListadoEmbarquesFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'Embarques.ListadoEmbarquesFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case &GridActions = 1
			Do 'Do CambiarFecha'
		Case &GridActions = 2
			Do 'Do Cargar'
		Case &GridActions = 3
			Do 'Do Continuar'
		Case &GridActions = 4
			Do 'Do cmdCretificadoCalidad'
		Case &GridActions = 5
			Do 'Do cmdValeSalida'
	EndCase
	&GridActions = 0
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		DB.EmbarqueDetalle.Call(TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(EmbarqueDetalleId))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_ReporteEmbarque)
		EmbarqueReporte.Call()
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */
